# dosa.dev

> Personal site of NaveenKumar N (QAInsights): performance engineering, AI tooling and open-source Chrome extensions.

## Links

- [Prompticon](https://dosa.dev/prompticon/): free, open-source (MIT) Chrome extension that adds a customizable quick-reply toolbar above the composer in ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok, Mistral Le Chat, Qwen Chat, Meta AI and DeepSeek; 100% client-side with zero tracking
- [QAInsights](https://qainsights.com): performance testing tools and JMeter resources
- [GitHub QAInsights](https://github.com/QAInsights): open-source projects including the Prompticon source code
